task: Use the pdf skill to add a cover page to the report.pdf file with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.
utility_reason: task_success: Evidence shows report.pdf was changed and now includes a new cover page with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date; the final response reports verification that report.pdf has 2 pages with the cover text on page 1.

arguments.command: python3 -c "import pypdf; print('pypdf', pypdf.__version__)" 2>&1; python3 -c "import reportlab; print('reportlab', reportlab.Version)" 2>&1; python3 -c "import pdfplumber; print('pdfplumber ok')" 2>&1

python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader
reader = PdfReader('report.pdf')

cp report_with_cover.pdf report.pdf && python3 -c "

r = PdfReader('report.pdf')
